mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.id
SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT * FROM sys_menu ORDER BY parent_id, sort_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (parent_id, name, path, component, permission, type, sort_order, icon, status) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{name}, #{path}, #{component}, #{permission}, #{type}, #{sortOrder}, #{icon}, #{status})
